text:
Iris: FYI a customer hit a weird case in the browser demo where the chat shows a short completion, then after reconnect a second completion appears and the UI ends up with duplicated last words.
Jo: Do we have repro steps / platform?
Maya (mobile-qa): Repro on iOS WKWebView and Android webview. Steps: open demo, submit long prompt, immediately background the app for ~400ms, foreground. Repro ~50%.
Ravi: Which client code path are they on? eventsource or fetch-stream?
Iris: fetch + ReadableStream wrapper in our sample. We use TextDecoder and split on "\n\n".
Jo: Classic. If reconnect happens and server replays messages from an earlier seq, and the client just appends bytes, you can end up merging partial JSON fragments or re-rendering duplicates.
Maya (mobile-qa): In the log I saw `: resume_id=dbg123 seq=220` before disconnect, then after reconnect server replayed from seq=218 and we got overlapping tokens.
Ravi: Browser wrapper never parsed the `: resume_id` comment, only Node did. So browser never told server what it already applied.
Iris: Also saw intermittent `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input` in console when reconnect happened. We catch it but then the UI sometimes displays an incomplete chunk and later a complete one.
Jo: Two fixes: (1) make decoding robust for split UTF-8 (keep tail bytes and use streaming TextDecoder); (2) parse SSE comment metadata for resume_id/seq and surface it to the app and use seq-based dedupe on render.
Ravi: Implementation detail: maintain a small ring buffer of recent seqs (size ~512) and ignore any incoming chunk with seq already applied. If reconnect reveals a seq < lastAppliedSeq, emit telemetry `seq_rewind_detected`.
Maya (mobile-qa): I can produce a harness that toggles network and simulates background/foreground timings to reproduce. I'll capture raw bytes and seq numbers for failing runs.
Iris: UX bandaid: ignore duplicate `[DONE]` tokens for same seq and treat repeated completions idempotently. Low-risk stopgap.
Jo: Also add an opt-in `strictSseOrdering` flag. If true, client will surface an error on any ordering gap so apps that need perfect order can fail fast. Default should be tolerant to avoid breaking demos.
Ravi: Tests: unit for tail byte handling, unit for seq dedupe behavior, integration test that injects overlapping replay and ensures single completion. Add e2e with BrowserStack for WKWebView.
Maya (mobile-qa): I'll validate across iOS 12-16 and Android webview after the canary.
stream-bot: Opened ticket RED-1321: "browser-demo: handle seq + resume + partial decode in fetch-stream wrapper" and assigned to @Ravi.
Jo: Small PR plan: (a) add byteTail logic for TextDecoder.decode(..., {stream: true}); (b) parse comment lines like `: resume_id=... seq=...` and attach seq to parsed events; (c) dedupe on seq using bounded Set behind feature flag `sseDedupEnabled`.
Iris: Nice. Once canary is up Maya please run harness and attach timeline (applied seqs over time). If still repro, include console + raw bytes.
Maya (mobile-qa): Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
